list.name: LoadId
list.query: select distinct LoadId from TestLoad union select 'Infraestructura' as LoadId order by LoadId desc

panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia para interpretar software backlevel, ciclo de vida y soporte.

options.content: Que muestra: hosts y componentes con software backlevel, fin de soporte o fin de vida. Como interpretarlo: Backlevel, EndOfSupport y EndOfLife elevan riesgo aun cuando la capacidad este OK. Accion sugerida: priorizar upgrades por severidad, servicio afectado y fecha de soporte.

panels.title: Resumen Backlevel
panels.description: Conteo de componentes por estado de backlevel, lifecycle y soporte.

targets.rawSql: select BacklevelStatus, LifecycleStatus, SupportStatus, count(*) as HostCount from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' group by BacklevelStatus, LifecycleStatus, SupportStatus order by case BacklevelStatus when 'Backlevel' then 1 when 'Current' then 2 else 3 end, LifecycleStatus

panels.title: Software y Evidencia por Host
panels.description: Detalle de hosts con version, vendor, lifecycle, backlevel y referencia directa a la evidencia cuando esta disponible.

targets.rawSql: select c.ComponentName as HostName, c.TechnologyType, c.Version, c.Vendor, c.DomainName, c.BusinessServiceId, c.BacklevelStatus, c.LifecycleStatus, c.SupportStatus, c.EndOfSupportDate, c.EvidenceState, coalesce(e.EvidenceReference, 'Sin evidencia disponible') as EvidenceReference, case when e.EvidenceReference is null then '#' else regexp_replace(e.EvidenceReference, '^https?://[^/]+', '') end as EvidencePath from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c left join EnterpriseEvidenceRecord e on e.ComponentId = c.ComponentId and e.LoadId = c.LoadId and e.EvidenceState = 'Available' where c.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by case c.BacklevelStatus when 'Backlevel' then 1 when 'Current' then 2 else 3 end, c.EndOfSupportDate nulls last, c.ComponentName

panels.title: Riesgos y Acciones Backlevel
panels.description: Riesgos lifecycle asociados a software backlevel con impacto y accion recomendada.

targets.rawSql: select r.Severity, c.ComponentName as HostName, c.BacklevelStatus, c.LifecycleStatus, c.EndOfSupportDate, r.Impact, r.RecommendedAction, r.EvidenceState, coalesce(e.EvidenceReference, 'Sin evidencia disponible') as EvidenceReference, case when e.EvidenceReference is null then '#' else regexp_replace(e.EvidenceReference, '^https?://[^/]+', '') end as EvidencePath from EnterpriseRiskRegistryEntry r join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentId = r.AffectedTechnologyId left join EnterpriseEvidenceRecord e on e.ComponentId = c.ComponentId and e.LoadId = c.LoadId and e.EvidenceState = 'Available' where r.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and r.RiskCategory = 'Lifecycle' order by case r.Severity when 'Critical' then 1 when 'High' then 2 when 'Medium' then 3 else 4 end, c.EndOfSupportDate nulls last
